title: Basic Foreign Area Officer (FAO) (I) (Gen to 2ndLt) FMOS, DC PP&O
raw_text:
10. MOS 8240, Basic Foreign Area Officer (FAO) (I) (Gen to 2ndLt) FMOS, DC
PP&O

    a. Summary. The Basic Foreign Area Officer (FAO) will be used to
identify those billets that require a designated FAO of any regional sub-
specialty (FMOS 8241 through 8249). It will also be used to identify
officers undergoing training as FAOs until they complete the requirements for
designation in a regional sub-specialty (FMOS 8241 through 8249). This MOS
may be assigned only as a FMOS. MOS 8240 will be assigned and voided only by
authority of CMC (MM).




                                         1-335                   Enclosure (1)
 1145                                                               NAVMC 1200.1L



    b. Prerequisites. Must have been selected to the international affairs
program through the commandant’s career-level education board and started the
national security affairs graduate degree program.

       c.   Requirements

        (1) Selected to attend graduate-level study of international
relations, with an emphasis in regional studies appropriate to a designated
region (Phase I); basic language training at the Defense Language Institute/
Foreign Language Center, Monterey, CA (Phase II); and designated overseas In-
Country training (Phase III).

        (2) At the end of Phase II, complete the Defense Language Proficiency
Test (DLPT) with a minimum score of Level 2 in all tested areas.

        (3) Must maintain a minimum tested language capability in a
designated language, in accordance with current regulations.

    d. Duties. Uses the language and knowledge of military forces, culture,
history, sociology, economics, politics, and geography of selected areas of
the world to perform duties as directed. Performs in operational and
strategic level Marine Corps, joint, or combined staffs in operations,
planning, security cooperation, or intelligence billets; or within the
Defense Attaché System (DAS).

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Political Scientists 19-3094.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
